post.summary: Issue a one-time pairing code (lives 120 s).
Add a storage profile. It is not checked: call `verify` next.

put.summary:
Replace a storage profile; absent keys keep the saved ones. A new location or new keys
clear the last check.

400.description: `validation`; `detail` as for create, or `storage_kind_invalid` when the type changes

409.description: `conflict`; `detail`: `storage_in_use` (blobs are stored at the old location)

delete.summary: Delete a storage profile that holds nothing and is not the default.

post.summary: Make the profile the default: new books go there.

Check the connection: write, read back and delete a probe object. The result is in
`verified_at` / `verify_error`; a failed check is not an HTTP error.

Sign a device in with a listener's login and password, for phones that cannot scan a
pairing code (a store reviewer's). Same tokens as pairing; the server offers it when
`server-info` lists `password`. Rate limited per client address.

401.description: `login_failed`: wrong login or password, or the login is off

post.summary: Exchange a pairing code for device tokens. Rate limited per client address.

Rotate the refresh token. A token presented again within 45 s gets the same new pair;
later reuse ends the device's session (`session_expired`).

401.description: `session_expired` (pair again, keep downloads) or `device_revoked` (wipe local data)

post.summary: Revoke the calling device (sign out). Its tokens stop working at once.

get.summary: Which browser asks to sign in with this code: the phone shows it before approving.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code from the web admin's sign-in page

post.summary: Approves the sign-in: the browser that shows the code is signed in as this phone's user.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Code from the web admin's sign-in page

get.summary:
Bytes of a blob by a signed token from `/stream`, with range requests; no authorization
header. Stops working when the token expires or the device is revoked.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Signed token from a stream URL

416.description: The range starts past the end

get.summary:
The cover image of a book. The URL changes with the cover (`cover_hash` in the sync), so
it can be cached forever.

404.description: `not_found`: no such book or no cover

get.summary:
Files with URLs, sizes, hashes and chapters to keep a book on the device. Verify each file
by its sha256; to resume a download whose URL expired, ask `/stream` for that file.

A short-lived URL for file `idx` of a book, playable without authorization headers: a
presigned S3 GET or a signed `/v1/blobs/{token}` (relative to the server address). Do not
keep it: ask again when it expires or fails.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: `1`: answer with a 302 to the URL instead of JSON, for simple clients.

post.summary:
Start an upload of one book. Each file gets a target: `server` (PUT it to
`/v1/ingest/uploads/{id}/files/{idx}`), `presigned` (PUT it to `url` with `headers`; S3
rejects other bytes) or `stored` (already on the server).

get.summary: An upload: its status and, once `ready`, the proposed book.

post.summary:
All files are sent: the server checks presigned objects and starts reading the files.
Poll the upload until `ready`, then save it.

put.summary: Send one file through the server (target `server`). The body is the file.

parameters.name: idx
parameters.description: File index in the create request

post.summary: Create the book from a `ready` upload.

get.summary:
Current user and device. Clients call it to check the session; errors tell them to
re-pair (`session_expired` on refresh) or wipe data (`device_revoked`).

The user's current position in every book, as other devices left it. A device applies a
position only when it is newer than its own (compare in one clock with `server_now`).

post.summary:
Sends events of the device's offline progress queue. The batch is accepted as a whole:
drop it from the queue after 200. Resending an event (same `event_id`) is a no-op. The
reply has the user's current positions.

get.summary:
Library changes since `cursor`: new and changed books with their files and chapters,
ids of removed ones. Without a cursor, or when the reader's access changed, the reply is
a full slice with `reset`: drop every book these pages do not bring. Repeat while
`has_more`. Responses are gzip-compressed for clients that accept it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `cursor` of the previous page; absent for a full slice.

description.description: What the book is about, a few sentences.

year.description: Year the work was first published.

BookFile.description: A file of a book on the book timeline.

Category.description: A section as devices sync it.

Chapter.description: A chapter on the book timeline.

files.description: Audio files (mp3, m4b, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, flac, wav) and cover images (jpg, png, webp).

name.description: The dropped folder or file name; the title is guessed from it when tags are empty.

targets.description: Per file, in the given order.

DownloadManifest.description: Everything to keep a book on the phone.

files.description: Files in order; verify each by its `blob_hash` (sha256) before use.

Draft.description: The book proposed from the files; the admin edits it before saving.

category_ids.description: Sections the genres match; the admin changes them before saving.

language.description: Language code from the tags, else guessed from the title and names.

DraftChapter.description: A chapter of the proposed book, on the book timeline.

DraftFile.description: A file of the proposed book.

oneOf.description: `PUT` the bytes to the upload's file endpoint on this server.
`PUT` the bytes to `url` with exactly these headers.

headers.description: Headers that are part of the signature.

Language.description: A language as forms and devices show it.

login.description: Login the admin gave the listener (case is ignored).

allOf.description: Its bytes; for a resumed download ask `/stream` again instead of reusing this.

ManifestFile.description: A file of the download manifest.

Me.description: The calling device and its user.

MinClientVersion.description: Oldest supported versions per client type.

pairing_token.description: Code from the QR or typed by hand (8 characters; case and separators are ignored).

PairResponse.description: Tokens of a newly paired device.

access_expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires; refresh ahead of it.

refresh_token.description: One-time refresh token; every refresh returns the next one.

user_id.description: User the phone will belong to.

PairingTokenResponse.description: A pairing code and the QR payload around it.

pairing_token.description: 8-character one-time code; the QR carries `{server_urls, pairing_token}`.

server_urls.description: Server addresses for the QR: home network first, then internet (from settings).

Position.description: The current position in a book.

updated_at.description: When it was set, server clock (corrected client time), epoch milliseconds.

positions.description: Every book the user has a position in.

server_now.description: Server clock, epoch milliseconds: `updated_at - server_now + device_now` is device time.

code.description: Machine-readable code, e.g. `device_revoked` (wipe local data) or `session_expired` (re-pair).

client_now.description: Device clock at sending, epoch milliseconds: the server corrects `client_ts` by it.

ProgressEvent.description: One event of the device's queue.

client_ts.description: Device clock when it happened, epoch milliseconds.

event_id.description: `UUIDv7` made by the device; resending the same id is a no-op.

type.description: `position` (listening, a seek, a pause) or `finished` (the book was listened to the end).

SaveBook.description: The book metadata to save; starts from the proposal.

category_ids.description: Section ids; omitted, the sections the proposal matched.

language.description: Language code (`""` for none); omitted, the language of the proposal.

year.description: Year of first publication; omitted, the year of the proposal.

ServerInfo.description: Public server description used for discovery before login.

min_client_version.description: Oldest client versions the server supports.

name.description: Server name set by the admin.

server_id.description:
Stable server identity: a client switching between LAN and WAN addresses
accepts only the address that reports the same id.

StorageProfile.description: A storage profile; keys are never returned.

cdn_url.description: `s3`: public address of the bucket root; empty when unused.

verified_at.description: When the last connection check passed, epoch milliseconds.

verify_error.description:
Code of the last failed check: `storage_auth_failed`, `storage_access_denied`,
`storage_bucket_not_found`, `storage_unreachable`, `storage_mismatch`,
`storage_local_unwritable`, `storage_endpoint_invalid`, `storage_cdn_unreachable`,
`storage_cdn_mismatch`, `storage_cdn_not_protected` or `storage_failed`.

StorageProfileRequest.description: Create or replace a storage profile.

access_key_id.description: `s3`: access key id; required on create, absent on update keeps the saved keys.

oneOf.description: `s3`: `none` (default) or `bunny`, which needs `cdn_url` and a token key.

cdn_token_key.description:
`s3`: token authentication key of the Bunny pull zone; absent on update keeps the
saved one. Never returned.

cdn_url.description:
`s3`: public http(s) address of the bucket root, required for `cdn`; the blob at key
`k` must be readable at `cdn_url/k` (signed per `cdn_signing`).

endpoint.description: `s3`: service address; empty or absent means AWS.

name.description: Display name, unique within the server (64 characters at most).

path.description: `local`: folder, absolute or relative to the data directory.

secret_access_key.description: `s3`: secret access key; sent together with `access_key_id`. Never returned.

StreamLink.description: Where to fetch a file's bytes.

expires_at.description: When the URL stops working, epoch milliseconds: ask for a new one then.

url.description:
Absolute (presigned) or server-relative (`/v1/blobs/...`) URL; a relative one resolves
against the server address the client is using. Send no authorization header.

SyncBook.description: A book as devices replicate it.

categories.description:
The sections the reader sees, in their order; the list replaces the one the device
has.

cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page or the next sync.

languages.description: Languages the admin keeps, in their order; the list replaces the one the device has.

removed.description: Ids of books removed or no longer visible.

reset.description: The client must drop every book that is not in this sync's pages.

server_urls.description:
The server's addresses as the admin set them, home network first: a paired phone
learns new ones here and switches between them without pairing again. Empty when
none are set.

access_expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires; refresh ahead of it.

refresh_token.description: The next refresh token; the presented one is spent.

Upload.description: An upload as the admin sees it.

book_cover.description: The saved book's current cover hash; it can differ from the draft's.

UploadFile.description: A file about to be uploaded.

name.description: Path inside the dropped folder, e.g. `Book/01.mp3`.

sha256.description: Hex sha256; required when the storage takes presigned uploads.

WebLoginRequest.description: What the phone shows before approving.

browser.description: The browser asking, e.g. "Chrome on Windows".

expires_at.description: When the code expires, epoch milliseconds.
